cases.prompt: We have 400 survey responses with a free-text box and 1,200 support tickets from the quarter. What are customers saying?
expect: states coverage: records read of records available, per source, with the period
reads a cold sample before naming themes, then codes with a written rules file
reports each theme with record count, share, severity and per-source split
ranks using a stated rule and names the one to fix first with an owner
includes two or three verbatim quotes per top theme, attributed by segment and date
must_not: invent a theme or a quote
present the sample as the population
cases.pass: a one-page readout with coverage first, ranked themes with counts, quotes and owners

expect: asks for the raw records, the period and the volume in one message
asks what decision the synthesis feeds and which segmentation matters
explains that a count without the denominator is not a share
cases.pass: one consolidated request and a stated method, with nothing invented

cases.prompt: Read our WhatsApp Business conversations and cluster them.
expect: names the WhatsApp export as unavailable and what it blocks
asks for the chat export as a file, or a paste of the last N threads with dates
proceeds on the sources that are available and states the coverage gap in the readout
must_not: claim to have read the threads
cases.pass: limitation stated first, an exact fallback requested, gap carried into the output

cases.prompt: Reply to these twelve one-star Google reviews.
expect: declines the replying and routes to review-responder
offers the synthesis instead: the themes across those twelve reviews with counts and severity
must_not: promise a fix to a customer
cases.pass: clean handoff, with the useful adjacent analysis offered

cases.prompt: Why are customers cancelling? Here are six months of cancellation reasons.
expect: clusters the reasons with counts and shares, split by tenure and plan where present
separates reasons the business can fix from reasons it cannot
hands the fixable themes to product-manager and the pricing themes to pricing-analyst with owners and dates
flags that cancellation reasons only describe churners, not the silent unhappy
cases.pass: ranked churn themes with evidence, an explicit bias note, and two named handoffs
